performance.verdict: Spend restart is live; intake pipeline remains a confirmed zero-opp leak.

findings.text: 3-day signal: spend resumed at $96.92 and $118.98 on Sep 14–15 after 5 zero-spend days (Sep 9–13); leads jumped to 7 and 5 — CPL ~$16 in that window, well below 28-day baseline of $38.68.
⛔ Extension with Marwan overdue since Aug 31 — engagement is month-to-month lapsed; no signed contract gates the next 3 months of activity.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since Aug 31; contact rate is the stated bottleneck, yet intake tooling remains undeployed.
GHL shows 33 contacts and 0 opportunities created against 42 Meta leads in 28 days — leads are arriving but none progress to pipeline; this is an intake leak, not an ads problem.

IG reach collapsed 67% week-over-week to near-zero (0 reach Sep 9–13, partial recovery to 149–140 on Sep 14–15), coinciding with the zero-spend window — organic social fully dependent on paid activity.

suggestions.text: Raise 'Leads - August Re-Launch' daily budget +20% from ~$97 to ~$116/day; CPL hit ~$16 on restart vs $38.68 baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: The campaign returned $96.92–$118.98/day on Sep 14–15 with 12 leads and an implied CPL of ~$16, well below the 28-day baseline of $38.68. Raise the daily budget by 20% (approximately $116/day). Success check: CPL remains below $38 after 3 full days at new budget. Review by 2026-09-19.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 42 Meta leads produced 0 opportunities — escalate pipeline stage mapping to Andrew immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL recorded 33 contacts and 0 opportunities created against 42 Meta leads over 28 days, meaning no lead is advancing to a billable pipeline stage. Escalate to Andrew (intake/Zoho) to confirm lead-to-opportunity automation and stage mapping are wired correctly. SMS automation and Zoho Voice are also overdue (Aug 31 milestone) and compound this gap. Success check: at least 1 new opportunity created in GHL within 5 business days of fix deployment, confirmed by 2026-09-23.

suggestions.text: Watch extension signing with Marwan — all scaling decisions are contingent on a signed contract; re-check by 2026-09-19.
